messages:
Maria Gomez: FYI opened PR #8421 to consolidate errref mappings and replace outdated SDK snippets. Found 3 broken links and one confusing example for 429 + streaming fallback.
Sam Patel: taking a look now — assigning to me for initial review :eyes:
Cheng Li: heads up, the streaming 429 case needs a different repro. When a stream is interrupted we sometimes surface a 429 after partial tokens; need to show how to resume vs fallback. I'll paste a minimal repro.
Cheng Li: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" -d '{"model":"rwd-light-1","input":"<long prompt>"}'
# then cut the connection after headers to simulate partial stream
```
Lina Torres: I can add a compact SDK snippet that shows context trimming + backoff. Something like: 
Lina Torres: ```python
# pseudocode
client.responses.create(..., timeout=30, retry_policy={"max_retries":3, "backoff":"exponential"})
# trim prompt to last 2048 tokens before send
```
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8421 — build queued
Sam Patel: CI failed on linting for samples/errref/429.md (line 12 link). I'll fix the link and push.
Maria Gomez: thanks — also can someone add a tiny note under Troubleshooting > 429 about preferring prefix-caching where possible? It reduces token count and avoids hitting rate limits during retries.
Cheng Li: +1. Also want to mention that client-side token windows should be aligned with server context limits to prevent silent truncation.
Lina Torres: pushed snippet changes in branch, left TODO to reference SDK v2 handler for resume semantics.
Sam Patel: done with link fix, re-ran CI, build passed :white_check_mark:
Maria Gomez: could one of you run the smoke curl in a low-traffic workspace to confirm the example reproduces the "stream -> 429" behavior? If green, I'll merge PR.
Cheng Li: running now, will report back in 10m.
Cheng Li: confirmed reproduction and added a note about using status_code == 429 vs error body in streaming case.
Maria Gomez: perfect, merging after squash. Thanks everyone :tada:
Lina Torres: can we add a short changelog blurb for the release notes? 429 docs update + snippet alignment.
Maria Gomez: yes, I'll add to release.md
Sam Patel: adding to changelog
Maria Gomez: closing thread.
